note.zh: 接近暗物质团块时，有机科学家进入 2410“心灵感应通讯”，机械科学家进入 2411“通讯已建立”。
note.en: Approaching the dark-matter mass leads an organic scientist to 2410 “Telepathic Communication” and a robotic one to 2411 “Communications Established”.

label.zh: 献出科学家：融合或悲剧
label.en: Offering the scientist: merge or tragedy

note.zh: 把科学家献作容器后，本阶段要么突破完成融合（2430），要么在某次掷骰时以每次 1.5% 的基础概率失败（2435）。灵能科学家走另一条无失败后备的路线（2431），格式塔帝国则可同化该实体（2440）。
note.en: After offering the scientist as a vessel the stage either breaks through and the merge succeeds (2430) or fails on a roll, base 1.5% per roll (2435). A psionic scientist takes a separate route without fallback (2431); gestalt empires may assimilate the entity instead (2440).

texts.zh:
我们发现自己身处一张巨大的网中。能量沿着网格状的墙壁有节奏地噼啪作响。

一团浓缩的暗物质云悬浮在这张纠结的网的深处。半透明的卷须向外探测能量屏障，接触后会产生火花，然后反冲回来。幽灵般的粒子像有规律地运动着。且不论这团幽灵般的物质是什么，它对我们的存在是没有反应的。
texts.en:
We find ourselves inside of an enormous mesh. Energy crackles rhythmically along its gridlike walls.

A concentrated cloud of dark matter is suspended deep within this tangled web. Translucent tendrils probe outward against the energy barrier, sparking on contact before recoiling back. The ghostly particles move as if patterned. Whatever this spectral mass may be, it has not reacted to our presence.

label.en: Approach the mass of dark matter.
Approach the mass of dark matter.

texts.zh:
这张网覆盖了巨大的面积，完全暴露在周围的空间中。建造它所使用的技术尚不为人所知，但可以合理地假设，它的设计目的是拦截和捕获非固体材料。

当我们环视四周时，只有那个云团在微微颤动。它是网格中唯一的其他存在。

在我们继续观察的过程中，我们观察到一种从矩阵延伸出来的装置。它似乎限制了流入网格的电流的强度。
texts.en:
Covering an enormous surface area, the mesh is fully exposed to the surrounding space. The technology used in its construction is unfamiliar, but it is reasonable to assume that it was designed to intercept and capture non-solid material.

The amorphous cloud stirred slightly as we surveyed our surroundings. It is the only other presence within the mesh.

As we continued our observations, a mechanism was observed extending from the matrix. It seems to be limiting the amplitude of the current flowing into the mesh.

texts.zh:
我们关闭了中央的装置，一道高能脉冲席卷整个网络内部。

卷须从幽灵般的云状物中分裂出来，拼命地冲破能量屏障。随着暗物质席卷而来焚毁了整个充能网络，中央的物质团失去了光芒。

一道强烈的蓝色火花点燃了整个结构的中心，把这些颗粒压缩成了原来尺寸的很小一部分。于是火花四溅，暗物质向外泼洒而出，在裂隙探球上覆盖了薄薄的一层。
texts.en:
We deactivated the central mechanism, sending waves of high energy coursing through the internals of the mesh.

Tendrils splintered from the spectral cloud, desperately thrusting against the energy barrier. The central mass grew faint as dark matter surged and burned against the energized mesh.

A violent blue spark ignited in the center of the structure, condensing the particles into a fraction of their original size. The spark then burst and dark matter showered outward, coating the Rift Sphere in a fine film.

note.zh: 拆除中央装置，能量灌满网格，暗物质团块被压缩成晶体；获得大量星界丝缕与暗物质，探索结束。
note.en: The central device is removed, energy floods the mesh and the dark-matter mass is compressed into a crystal; a large astral thread reward and dark matter; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
在我们接近那团虚无缥缈的物质时，我们的[Explorer.GetNetworkName]中探测到一个源自[Leader.GetName]的独立但良性的意识。它似乎正在我们整个集体知识和记忆中搜索着。

这个实体搅动着，一段信息出现在我们的意识中：“我从来没有见到过你们这样的东西，你们是什么呀？”
texts.en:
As we approached the ethereal mass, an independent yet benign consciousness was detected in our [Explorer.GetNetworkName] originating from [Leader.GetName]. It appeared to be searching through our collective knowledge and memories.

The entity stirred, and a message appeared in our minds: "I have never encountered your kind before. What are you?"

texts.zh:
在我们接近那团虚无缥缈的物质时，我们开始在意识中感受到某种存在。看似随机的知识片段被挖掘出来，旧的记忆也被唤起。尽管有侵入性的存在，但我们没有感觉到恶意或不适。

这个实体搅动着，一段信息出现在我们的意识中：“我从来没有见到过你们这样的东西，你们是什么呀？”
texts.en:
As we approached the ethereal mass, we began to feel a presence in our minds. Seemingly random bits of knowledge were dredged up, and old memories stirred. Despite the invasive presence, we sensed no malicious intent or discomfort.

The entity stirred, and a message appeared in our minds: "I have never encountered your kind before. What are you?"

label.en: We are strangers to this place.

label.zh: 我们是来自异世界的探险家。
label.en: We are explorers from another world.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the species' name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

texts.zh:
该实体听取了我们的答复，于是另一条信息响起：“又一个好奇的物种，很高兴见到你们。”

“我的同类构成了现实的基石。我们也是流浪者和探索者，对体验宇宙有着极大的兴趣。遗憾的是，另一种生命形式却只是把我们当做物质矿藏；一种随手可得的能量来源，可以随意抓捕和收割。

“我们可以共存，我们的实力相结合足以将科学推向新的边界。”

“在你们的帮助下我可以逃出这个监狱。你们的物种与我不谋而合，我只希望能加入你们的集体意识。我会把我自己的意识融入整个[Leader.Species.GetBrainJunctionName]当中，在所有科学的领域中增进洞见。”
texts.en:
The entity considered our response. Another message rang out: "Another curious species, it is fascinating to meet you."

"My kind makes up the building blocks of reality. We are also wanderers and explorers who take great interest in experiencing the universe. Regrettably, another lifeform saw us as a mere material deposit; a passing fuel source to be captured and harvested."

"We will coexist, with our combined prowess we will push our scientific boundaries to new heights."

"With your help, I can escape this prison. Your kind is compatible with my intentions, I wish only to join your collective consciousness. I will diffuse my mind across your [Leader.Species.GetBrainJunctionName] and enhance your insight in all scientific endeavors."

label.en: Offer this scientist as a vessel.

label.zh: 给这位科学官准备一个容器。
label.en: Offer this scientist as a vessel.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

notes.zh: 选项按帝国与科学家而定：非格式塔、非灵能科学家可“献出科学家作为容器”（平等主义帝国不可选，且有失败后备），灵能科学家走 2431；非格式塔帝国可拒绝（→ 2420）；格式塔帝国改为“同化该实体”（→ 2440）或“拒绝同化”（→ 2420）。
notes.en: Options depend on empire and scientist: a non-gestalt, non-psionic scientist may be “offered as a vessel” (not allowed for egalitarian empires; has a failure fallback), a psionic scientist goes to 2431; non-gestalt empires may deny (→ 2420); gestalt empires instead “assimilate” (→ 2440) or “deny assimilation” (→ 2420).

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]被绑在诊断台上，意识转移开始了。他不安地扭动着身体，外来的意识逐渐淹没大脑，导致了无法控制的痉挛。幽灵般的实体变成了不稳定能量的漩涡。突然间，一切归于平静，[Leader.GetName]以一种新的姿态站了起来。

这个幽魂般的物质团陷入了沉默，然后平铺到了整个网络上。
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] was bound to a diagnostic bench, and the transfer began. They writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably as the foreign consciousness overwhelmed their mind. The ghostly entity became a churning vortex of unstable energy. Suddenly, everything went quiet, and [Leader.GetName] rose with a new demeanor.

Now fully inert, the spectral mass diffused evenly throughout the mesh.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

note.zh: 实体融入科学家：其原有特质全部被替换（技能 5，学者、坚韧、位面理论家、灵能、裂隙行者、外来意识）；大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: The entity merges into the scientist: all previous traits are replaced (skill 5; scholar, Resilient, Planar Theorist, Psionic, Riftwalker, Foreign Consciousness); a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]被绑在诊断台上，意识转移开始了。他不安地扭动着身体，外来的意识尝试占据大脑，导致了无法控制的痉挛。然而，[Leader.GetName]挣脱了束缚，取出了隐藏的武器，紧接着就结束了自己的生命，过程中一同带走那个虚无缥缈的生物。

团队里剩下的人试着在这个空间中收集有用的材料，包括大量暗物质，然后启程返航。
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] was bound to a diagnostic bench, and the transfer began. They writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably as the foreign consciousness attempted to occupy their mind. However, [Leader.GetName] managed to escape their restraints and recover a concealed weapon. They subsequently took their own life, killing both themselves and the ethereal creature in the process.

The remaining team attempted to gather whatever other resources were available within this space before returning, including a significant amount of dark matter.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

note.zh: 失败分支：正文写科学家挣脱束缚后自尽，与实体同归于尽；获得大量星界丝缕与暗物质，探索结束。（评注：脚本中没有杀死领袖的效果。）
note.en: Failure branch: the text says the scientist broke free and took their own life, killing the entity too; a large astral thread reward and dark matter; the exploration ends. (Commentary: the script contains no leader-killing effect.)

texts.zh:
幽灵般的实体变成了不稳定能量的漩涡。[Leader.GetName]不安地扭动着身体，无法控制地痉挛。突然，他站了起来，脸上带着茫然而又沉思的表情。短暂的停顿之后，他向团队的其他成员做了一个[Leader.GetName]的手势，并示意返回科研船。

这个幽魂般的物质团陷入了沉默，然后平铺到了整个网络上。
texts.en:
The ghostly entity became a churning vortex of unstable energy. [Leader.GetName] writhed with discomfort, spasming uncontrollably. Suddenly, they rose with a blank yet pensive expression. After a brief pause, they acknowledged the rest of the team with a gesture of their [Leader.GetName] and motioned to return to the Science vessel.

Now fully inert, the spectral mass diffused evenly throughout the mesh.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

note.zh: 灵能科学家接纳实体，保留原有特质并获得坚韧、位面理论家（或二级）与外来意识；大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: A psionic scientist hosts the entity, keeping their traits and gaining Resilient, Planar Theorist (or its tier II) and Foreign Consciousness; a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
一声歇斯底里的哀号穿过内部通讯的本地线路。

这个虚无缥缈的生物对我们的拒绝做出了激烈的反应，它以狂暴的光谱卷须和火花猛烈地拍打着网状结构。

几分钟后，一切平静下来。精疲力竭的实体重新打开了通信。”行吧。如果你不希望我的加入，那么至少赐给我死亡的仁慈。”

它用卷须做了个手势，继续说，“关闭这个装置会激活这个网格，让我的粒子失去活性。被囚禁的日子是一点也过不下去了。”
texts.en:
A primordial wail traversed local lines of internal communication.

The ethereal creature reacted violently to our rejection, lashing out against the meshed structure in a furious wave of spectral tendrils and sparks.

After a few minutes, it settled. The exhausted entity reopened communications. "Very well. If you do not wish for me to join you, then at least give me the mercy of death."

Gesturing with a tendril, it continued, "Deactivating this mechanism will energize this mesh, rendering my particles inert. A life imprisoned is no life at all."

note.zh: 应囚徒请求让其安息；获得大量星界丝缕与暗物质，探索结束。
note.en: At the prisoner's request it is given release; a large astral thread reward and dark matter; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
我们一做出明确的决定，这个虚无缥缈的生物立刻就建立了通讯线路。暗物质的每一根卷须都缩回了它的中心的物质团。

我们已经部署了无人侦察机和数据基础设施来对这个装置和它的囚犯进行交叉观察。

从我们从裂隙撤退到现在已经过去好几天了，那个实体仍旧一动不动。
texts.en:
Once our decision was made clear, the ethereal creature immediately severed lines of communication. Every tendril of its dark matter withdrew back into its central mass.

We have deployed surveillance drones and data infrastructure for cross-rift observation of this device and its prisoner.

Days have passed since our exit back through the rift, and the entity still has yet to move.

texts.zh:
我们一做出明确的决定，这个虚无缥缈的生物立刻就建立了意识连接。暗物质的每一根卷须都缩回了它的中心的物质团。

我们已经部署了无人侦察机和数据基础设施来对这个装置和它的囚犯进行交叉观察。

从我们从裂隙撤退到现在已经过去好几天了，那个实体仍旧一动不动。
texts.en:
Once our decision was made clear, the ethereal creature immediately severed the mental connection. Every tendril of its dark matter withdrew back into its central mass.

We have deployed surveillance drones and data infrastructure for cross-rift observation of this device and its prisoner.

Days have passed since our exit back through the rift, and the entity still has yet to move.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.System.GetName]的裂隙另一头研究的实体被它所处的维度中的某个未知操作者摧毁了。我们收集的研究数据到此为止。
texts.en: The entity on the side of the rift we were studying in [From.System.GetName] has been neutralized by an unknown actor within its own dimension. The research data we were collecting has ceased.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

note.zh: 保留囚徒用于研究，裂隙处留下物理与工程研究矿藏；数年后，其所在维度中的未知者消灭了该实体，矿藏随之消失。
note.en: Keeping the prisoner for study leaves physics and engineering research deposits at the rift; some years later an unknown actor in its own dimension destroys the entity, and the deposits are removed.

texts.zh:
我们关闭了中央的装置，一道高能脉冲席卷整个网络内部。

卷须从幽灵般的生物中分裂出来，拼命地冲破能量屏障。随着暗物质席卷而来焚毁了整个充能网络，中央的物质团失去了光芒。

一道强烈的蓝色火花点燃了整个结构的中心，把这个实体压缩成了原来尺寸的很小一部分。于是火花四溅，暗物质向外泼洒而出，在裂隙探球上覆盖了薄薄的一层。
texts.en:
We deactivated the central mechanism, sending waves of high energy coursing through the internals of the mesh.

Tendrils splintered from the spectral creature, desperately thrusting against the energy barrier. The central mass grew faint as dark matter surged and burned against the energized mesh.

A violent blue spark ignited in the center of the structure, condensing the entity into a fraction of their original size. The spark then burst and dark matter showered outward, coating the Rift Sphere in a fine film.

note.zh: 非友好帝国直接杀死它；获得大量星界丝缕与暗物质，探索结束。
note.en: Unfriendly empires simply kill it; a large astral thread reward and dark matter; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
数据传输开始后，这个虚无缥缈的实体也开始向自身内部旋转和皱缩。几千年的知识和经验流入了我们的网络之中。基于这些信息的优化也开始实装。

这个幽魂般的物质团陷入了沉默，然后平铺到了整个网络上。
texts.en:
The ethereal entity swirled and thrashed within itself as the stream of data began. Millennia of knowledge and observations entered the network. Optimizations based on this information were implemented accordingly.

Now fully inert, the spectral mass diffused evenly throughout the mesh.

texts.zh:
随着我们把它的意识吸收进我们的意识织构内，这个虚无缥缈的实体开始向自身内部旋转和皱缩。几千年的知识和经验流入了我们更大的意识之中。

这个幽魂般的物质团陷入了沉默，然后平铺到了整个网络上。
texts.en:
The ethereal entity swirled and thrashed within itself as we absorbed its consciousness into the mind weave. Millennia of knowledge and observations entered our greater consciousness.

Now fully inert, the spectral mass diffused evenly throughout the mesh.

note.zh: 格式塔帝国把实体同化进集体意识；获得永久“外来意识”修正与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: A gestalt empire assimilates the entity into its collective; the permanent Foreign Consciousness modifier and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
在我们接近那团虚无缥缈的物质时，我们的[Explorer.GetNetworkName]中探测到一个源自[Leader.GetName]的独立但良性的意识。它似乎正在我们整个集体知识和记忆中搜索着。

这个实体搅动着，一段信息通过球体的内部通讯网络播放了出来：“我从来没有见到过你们这样的东西，你们是什么呀？”
texts.en:
As we approached the ethereal mass, an independent yet benign consciousness was detected in our [Explorer.GetNetworkName] originating from [Leader.GetName]. It appeared to be searching through our collective knowledge and memories.

The entity stirred, and a message was broadcast through the Sphere's internal communication network: "I have never encountered your kind before. What are you?"

texts.zh:
在我们接近那团虚无缥缈的物质时，我们开始在意识中感受到某种存在。看似随机的知识片段被挖掘出来，旧的记忆也被唤起。尽管有侵入性的存在，但我们没有感觉到恶意或不适。

这个实体搅动着，一段信息通过球体的内部通讯网络播放了出来：“我从来没有见到过你们这样的东西，你们是什么呀？”
texts.en:
As we approached the ethereal mass, we began to feel a presence in our minds. Seemingly random bits of knowledge were dredged up, and old memories stirred. Despite the invasive presence, we sensed no malicious intent or discomfort.

The entity stirred, and a message was broadcast through the Sphere's internal communication network: "I have never encountered your kind before. What are you?"

label.en: We are strangers to this place.

label.zh: 我们是来自异世界的探险家。
label.en: We are explorers from another world.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the species' name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 纠缠的暗物质 / Entangled Dark Matter

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes

## 如何开始 How it starts

裂隙类型从探索帝国的裂隙池中按权重抽取，权重 1，无额外条件（`00_astral_rifts.txt:322–331`）。每阶段结束掷 1–10 的骰子，加技能与线索、减难度，≥14 进入下一章；第一章 2400 难度为 0。

Drawn by weight from the explorer's rift pool, weight 1, no extra conditions (`00_astral_rifts.txt:322–331`). Each phase ends with a d10 plus skill and clues minus difficulty; 14+ opens the next chapter. Chapter 2400 has difficulty 0.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 奇怪的网（2400）：探球身处一张巨大的能量网中，网的深处困着一团暗物质云，它的触须一碰到网就迸出火花。检查网（→ 2405）或接近暗物质团（有机科学家 → 2410，机械科学家 → 2411）。
2. 有限电流（2405）：这张网是为捕获非实体物质而建造的，中央装置限制着电流。拆除装置（→ 2425，结束）或调查被困的团块（→ 2410 / 2411）。
3. 心灵感应通讯（2410）/ 通讯已建立（2411）：团块是一个有意识的存在，问“你们是什么？”——三个回答都通向 2415。
4. 不祥提案（2415）：它的种族是“构成现实的基石”，同样热爱探索，却被另一种生命当作燃料捕获。它请求借科学家的身体作为容器离开。
   - 非格式塔帝国：献出科学家（非灵能者 → 2430 / 失败 2435；灵能者 → 2431）或拒绝（→ 2420）。
   - 格式塔帝国：同化它（→ 2440）或拒绝同化（→ 2420）。
5. 囚徒的请求（2420）：遭拒后它请求至少给它解脱。安乐死（→ 2426，非“非友好”帝国）、保留以供研究（→ 2445），或直接杀死（→ 2427，非友好帝国）。

1. Strange Mesh (2400): the Sphere is inside a vast energy mesh holding a cloud of dark matter whose tendrils spark against the barrier. Examine the mesh (→ 2405) or approach the mass (organic scientist → 2410, robotic → 2411).
2. Limited Current (2405): the mesh was built to trap non-solid matter; a central device limits its current. Remove the device (→ 2425, ending) or investigate the captive (→ 2410 / 2411).
3. Telepathic Communication (2410) / Communications Established (2411): the mass is a conscious being asking “What are you?” — all three answers lead to 2415.
4. An Ominous Proposal (2415): its kind are “the building blocks of reality”, wanderers like us, captured by another lifeform as fuel. It asks to leave inside the scientist's body.
   - Non-gestalt empires: offer the scientist (non-psionic → 2430 / failure 2435; psionic → 2431) or deny (→ 2420).
   - Gestalt empires: assimilate it (→ 2440) or deny assimilation (→ 2420).
5. A Prisoner's Plea (2420): refused, it asks at least for release. Euthanize it (→ 2426, not-unfriendly empires), keep it for study (→ 2445), or kill it (→ 2427, unfriendly empires).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 2425 / 2426 / 2427：实体被能量网压缩成晶体而死；大量星界丝缕与暗物质。
- 2430 吸收意识：科学家所有原有特质被替换（技能 5，学者、坚韧、位面理论家、灵能、裂隙行者、外来意识）。
- 2431 吸收意识（灵能者）：保留原特质，加坚韧、位面理论家与外来意识。
- 2435 不幸的难题（失败分支，基础 1.5%/次掷骰）：正文写科学家挣脱束缚后自尽，与实体同归于尽；大量星界丝缕与暗物质。（评注：脚本中没有杀死领袖的效果。）
- 2440 同化：格式塔帝国获得永久“外来意识”修正。
- 2445 笼中鸟：留下监视设备，裂隙获得物理与工程研究矿藏；约 3600–3960 天后 2450：实体被其维度中的未知者消灭，矿藏移除。
- 以上都结束探索（2450 在探索结束多年后发生）。

- 2425 / 2426 / 2427: the mesh crushes the entity into a crystal; a large astral thread reward and dark matter.
- 2430 Absorbed Consciousness: all of the scientist's traits are replaced (skill 5; scholar, Resilient, Planar Theorist, Psionic, Riftwalker, Foreign Consciousness).
- 2431 Absorbed Consciousness (psionic): traits kept, plus Resilient, Planar Theorist and Foreign Consciousness.
- 2435 Unfortunate Complications (failure branch, base 1.5% per roll): the text says the scientist broke free and took their own life, killing the entity as well; a large astral thread reward and dark matter. (Commentary: the script has no leader-killing effect.)
- 2440 assimilation: gestalt empires gain the permanent Foreign Consciousness modifier.
- 2445 Life in a Cage: surveillance is left in place and the rift gains physics and engineering research deposits; about 3600–3960 days later 2450: the entity is neutralised by an unknown actor in its own dimension and the deposits are removed.
- All end the exploration (2450 comes years later).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 科学家是有机还是机械、是否灵能者，帝国是否格式塔/平等主义/非友好，都会改变可选项（见上）。2410、2411、2415、2420、2440、2445 有格式塔、蜂巢、机械或灵能版本文字。

- Whether the scientist is organic or robotic or psionic, and whether the empire is gestalt, egalitarian or unfriendly, change the available options (see above). 2410, 2411, 2415, 2420, 2440 and 2445 have gestalt, hive, machine or psionic texts.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（全篇 whole story；原独立的失败事件 2435 已并入 / former standalone failure event 2435 merged in）
- 来源 Sources：`common/astral_rifts/00_astral_rifts.txt:322`；`events/astral_rifts_2_events.txt:1515–2154`（2400–2450）
- 已核对：裂隙定义；2400–2450 全部事件；2415 中两个同名选项“献出科学家”，只有第一个（非灵能者）带 `on_roll_failed = astral_rift.2435`（`astral_rifts_2_events.txt:1721–1740`）；2445 → 2450（3600+360 天）。
- 修正：编译图漏掉失败分支，2435 曾是独立故事；已用桥接并入，标注互斥组与各结局。
- 不确定：2435 正文描述科学家自尽，但脚本未移除该领袖；按脚本原样记录。

- Checked: rift definition; every event 2400–2450; of the two “Offer this scientist as a vessel” options in 2415 only the first (non-psionic) carries `on_roll_failed = astral_rift.2435` (`astral_rifts_2_events.txt:1721–1740`); 2445 → 2450 (3600+360 days).
- Correction: the compiled graph missed the failure branch and 2435 had been a separate story; merged with a bridge, with exclusive groups and all endings labelled.
- Uncertain: 2435's text describes the scientist's suicide but the script does not remove the leader; recorded as the script has it.
